title: Aperture
description: Aperture daemon, sessions, storage and live session metrics.

panels.title: Running sessions
panels.description: Sessions whose browser is running.

panels.title: Suspended sessions
panels.description: Idle sessions stopped to save resources; they wake on the next connection.

panels.title: Live clients
panels.description: Clients connected to live sessions across all sessions.

panels.title: Active recordings
panels.description: Recordings currently starting or running.

panels.title: API requests
panels.description: Requests per second on the API listener.

panels.title: API 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of API responses with a 5xx status.

panels.title: API requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second on the API listener.

panels.title: API latency
panels.description: Latency quantiles across all API routes.

panels.title: API errors by code
panels.description: API error responses per second by error code.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: The ten routes with the highest p95 latency.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, route, method) (rate(aperture_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: The ten routes with the most requests per second.

panels.title: Build
panels.description: Version and deployment color of the daemon serving metrics.

panels.title: In-flight API requests
panels.description: Requests the API listener is serving now.

panels.title: Daemon uptime
panels.description: Time since the serving daemon started.

panels.title: Unreachable wrappers
panels.description: Running sessions whose wrapper did not answer the last metrics poll.

panels.title: Sessions by status
panels.description: Retained sessions by lifecycle status; expired sessions are left out.

panels.title: Lifecycle transitions
panels.description: Session lifecycle transitions per interval.

panels.title: Browser start duration (p95)
panels.description: Time from starting resources until the browser answers CDP.

panels.title: Snapshots
panels.description: Snapshots whose files still exist.

panels.title: Promotions
panels.description: Session promotions per interval by result.

panels.title: Promotion duration
panels.description: Duration quantiles of successful promotions.

panels.title: Filesystem usage
panels.description: Used share of the filesystems holding store_root, cold_root and the database.

targets.expr: 1 - max by (root) (aperture_storage_available_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (root) (aperture_storage_size_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Available space
panels.description: Bytes available to Aperture per storage root.

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: SQLite database including its write-ahead log.

panels.title: GC runs
panels.description: Garbage collection runs per interval by result.

panels.title: GC duration
panels.description: Average duration of garbage collection runs.

panels.title: GC removals
panels.description: Items garbage collection removed per interval by kind.

panels.title: GC and scrape errors
panels.description: Upload staging sweep errors and state sources a scrape could not read.

panels.title: Live clients by role and transport
panels.description: Connected live session clients; transport none means reconnecting.

panels.title: Media viewers and CDP connections
panels.description: WebRTC media viewers by role and open CDP connections.

panels.title: Recordings
panels.description: Active recordings, recordings started and failures by reason per interval.

panels.title: Upload throughput
panels.description: Bytes uploaded into sessions per second.

panels.title: Uploads
panels.description: Files uploaded and failed upload requests per interval.

panels.title: Proxy connections
panels.description: Session SOCKS proxy connections: active, accepted and failed per second.

panels.title: Session wrappers
panels.description: Running session wrappers by whether the last poll reached them, and attached local tunnels.

panels.title: Wrapper polling
panels.description: Duration of the last poll of every wrapper and failed wrapper requests per interval.

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Successful web logins per interval by method.

panels.title: Authentication failures
panels.description: Rejected logins and request authentications per interval.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines in the daemon.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory and Go heap in use.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds the daemon uses per second.

panels.title: GC pauses and file descriptors
panels.description: Go GC pause time per second and open file descriptors.
